load_MPII_annotations: load MPII format annotations and convert them to COCO-style instance and image lists
convert_MPII_to_COCO_keypoints: convert MPII keypoints to COCO keypoint format using the MPII_TO_COCO_INDICES mapping
build_MPII_to_COCO_mapping: build the MPII_TO_COCO_INDICES dictionary that maps MPII joint indices to COCO joint indices
review_Mpii2CocoDataset_class: review the Mpii2CocoDataset class that extends BaseCocoStyleDataset for MPII to COCO conversion
summarize_bbox_conversion: summarize how MPII center-scale bounding boxes are converted to xyxy format using bbox_cs2xyxy
